# google-pagespeed-insights-api

> Async Rust client for the Google PageSpeed Insights API v5. One call runs Lighthouse on a public URL and returns category scores (performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO), lab metrics (FCP, LCP, TBT, CLS, Speed Index), every audit, and Chrome UX Report Core Web Vitals field data (p75 of LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) for the URL and its origin.

Crate name: `google-pagespeed-insights-api` (import as `google_pagespeed_insights_api`). MSRV 1.88, Tokio, reqwest with rustls.

Public items:

- `PageSpeedInsightsApi::{new, with_api_key, with_access_token, with_quota_project, with_client, with_base_url}`; `run_pagespeed(&RunPagespeedRequest) -> Result<PagespeedResponse, GoogleApiError>`; `run_pagespeed_raw(..) -> Result<serde_json::Value, _>`
- `RunPagespeedRequest::new(url)` with `.strategy(Strategy::{Mobile, Desktop})`, `.category(..)`, `.categories(Category::ALL)`, `.locale("en")`, `.utm_campaign(..)`, `.utm_source(..)`, `.captcha_token(..)`
- `Category::{Performance, Accessibility, BestPractices, Seo, AgenticBrowsing, Pwa}`; `Category::ALL` (the first four); `lighthouse_id()` gives `performance`, `best-practices`, ...
- `PagespeedResponse::{category_score, page_field_summary, origin_field_summary, lab_summary}`; fields `id`, `loading_experience`, `origin_loading_experience`, `lighthouse_result`
- `LighthouseResult::{audit(id), category(Category), category_score, failing_audits(Category)}`; `audits: BTreeMap<String, LighthouseAudit>`
- `FieldSummary { overall, origin_fallback, lcp, inp, cls, fcp, ttfb }` where each is `Option<FieldValue { p75, category }>`; CLS already divided by 100
- `LabSummary { performance_score, fcp, lcp, tbt, cls, speed_index, server_response_time }` in milliseconds
- `GoogleApiError::{Connection, JsonParse, HttpStatus(u16, String), InvalidArgument}` (non-exhaustive), `status()`, `reason()`, `is_timeout()`

All response types implement `Serialize`. Without a key the shared quota is often exhausted (429). Audit `details` are `serde_json::Value`. For CrUX history or origin queries without Lighthouse, use the `google-crux-api` crate.
